finding.statement: For C66-TATE-SUPPORT at (g,n)=(6,6), the hypothesis RED-0001 ('T = W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(8)') is sufficient for the Tate type of the interface subquotient T_Z, because T_Z is a subobject of T and FND-0033 applies, but it is not necessary, and no artifact may assert that discharging C66-TATE-SUPPORT requires settling RED-0001. Two adjudicated inputs already discharge the subproblem without touching RED-0001: FND-0185 (Tate-ness of W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y) implies Tate-ness of T_Z, through the FND-0180 image form T_Z = im(W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y)->T)) and FND-0186 (dimension-threshold vanishing of the Y'-supported contribution). The FND-0185 hypothesis concerns a closed support of dimension at most 17 and is logically incomparable with RED-0001, so sufficiency in one direction confers no necessity in the other. Only the contrapositive is valid: a non-Tate subquotient of T_Z refutes RED-0001. Consequently a conditional whose antecedent is RED-0001 is campaign-circular and cannot satisfy a weakest-sufficient-proof lane for this subproblem, since a weaker and non-circular sufficient input is already adjudicated.
